logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output text/plain --- '[get-transferencia-exp] START - id=' ++ ((attributes.uriParams.id default 'N/A') as String)]

ee:transform.doc:name: Translate BIAN order to mobile response

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var pis = payload.PaymentInstructions.PaymentInstructionStatus var statusType = pis.PaymentInstructionStatusType default "Rejected" var statusReason = pis.PaymentInstructionStatus.StatusReason.Text var codigoRechazo = if (statusReason == "INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS") "SALDO_INSUFICIENTE" else if (statusReason == "ACCOUNT_BLOCKED") "CUENTA_BLOQUEADA" else null --- { id: vars.transferenciaid, estado: if (statusType == "Completed") "APROBADA" else "RECHAZADA", (codigoRechazo: codigoRechazo) if (statusType != "Completed"), monto: payload.Amount.AmountValue.Value as Number, moneda: payload.Amount.AmountCurrency.Currencycode default "USD", cuentaOrigen: payload.PayerProductInstanceReference.ProductReference.ProductIdentification.ProductIdentification.IdentifierValue.Value, cuentaDestino: payload.PayeeProductInstanceReference.ProductReference.ProductIdentification.ProductIdentification.IdentifierValue.Value, bancoDestino: payload.PayeeBankReference.PartyReference.PartyIdentification.PartyIdentification.IdentifierValue.Value, concepto: upper(payload.RemittanceInformation.Text as String), fechaSolicitud: payload.Date.DateTimeContent, fechaProcesamiento: pis.PaymentInstructionStatus.StatusDateTime.DateTimeContent }

logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output text/plain --- '[get-transferencia-exp] END - id=' ++ ((vars.transferenciaid default 'N/A') as String) ++ ' | estado=' ++ ((payload.estado default 'N/A') as String)]
